This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.284/2023 registered at Police Station Suthaliya, District Rajgarh (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 302, 201, 376(2)(n) and 386/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
The applicant is in custody since 12/08/2023.
